$comment: Typecheck-only, for `test/*.test.ts`. NOT used to build the package.
`node --test` on Node 24 strips types rather than checking them, which is
the same hole vitest has — ADR 0002 §4a's measurement exists because a
transpiler's silence is not a compiler's approval, and Ship's CI once
reported success for 49 commits of a React rewrite it never compiled. So the
`types: ["node"]` and `lib` including DOM appear here and MUST NOT leak into
tsconfig.json: the tests import node:test and touch globalThis on purpose,
while the published package may reach for neither. That the two configs
This pass needs `dist/` to exist, because the tests import `../dist/index.js`
on purpose — dist is what ships. So `npm run typecheck` builds first. It read
`tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` for one commit,
which passed in CI (where a build step runs before it) and failed on a fresh
clone with eleven TS2307s that look like the package is broken.
